title: Paddy McGuinness 'freaked the hell out' after seeing ghostly figure beside his bed
excerpt: Paddy McGuinness has revealed he was left “freaked the hell out” after seeing a mysterious figure standing beside his bed.
content:
Paddy McGuinness has revealed he was left “freaked the hell out” after seeing a mysterious figure standing beside his bed.

The Bolton-born TV presenter shared the spooky encounter as the terrifying ghost story Witch Farm airs on BBC and the darker nights bring ghost stories firmly back into season.

Paddy said the experience was particularly unsettling because his two daughters had previously spoken about seeing what appeared to be the same figure in their home.

Speaking on his popular Sunday Radio 2 show, he said his youngest daughter first mentioned seeing a “tall white man” in the house around two weeks earlier.

Paddy initially wondered whether somebody had been in the property while he was away, but was careful not to make a fuss in front of his daughter in case he frightened her.

He said: “I didn’t want to freak my youngest daughter out.

“She went, ‘Yeah, I’ve seen him in the house.’”

But things became stranger when his eldest daughter, Penelope, apparently revealed she had also seen the figure on a separate occasion.

Paddy said: “They’d seen him on another occasion and they both spoke about it.

“I’ve got to say, it freaked me out.”

Despite insisting he is not someone with “a mad passion about believing in ghosts”, Paddy said he was left shaken by what happened next.

At around 1.30am to 1.45am, he woke suddenly in bed and saw what appeared to be a figure beside him.

He said: “Stood right at the side of me, at my bed, tall white figure.

“And as quick as it was there, he disappeared.

“I’m telling you, I was covered head to toe in sweat and goosebumps.”

Paddy said the experience had left him questioning whether he had really seen something in his home or whether there could be a more earthly explanation.

He said: “I don’t believe in ghosts and I don’t have a mad passion about believing in ghosts.

“People say they’ve seen them. My kids are the most innocent kids in the world.

“When my youngest daughter said that and then my oldest daughter backed it up on a separate occasion, they don’t tell lies like that.”

And after his own encounter, Paddy appealed for anyone with an explanation to get in touch.

He said: “Have you seen a ghost or is it something in my brain?

“Are you an expert on sleep? Can you explain it to me? Because I’m telling you now, it freaked me the hell out.”

There was at least one rather less frightening way for Paddy to calm himself down.

After the encounter, he said he eventually distracted himself by getting his phone out and looking at hoovers in the Black Friday sales.
